hotspots.title: Howard Lutnick Nvidia Export Probe & Firing Crisis
hotspots.blurb: Scrutiny intensifies around Commerce Secretary nominee Howard Lutnick following allegations surrounding chip export enforcement and Chinese spy warnings involving Nvidia's executive leadership. The White House faces mounting Congressional pressure as MAGA commentary turns critical over tech sector security vulnerabilities.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes national security anxiety combined with internal administration infighting creates maximum affective turbulence in MAGA media.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox has officially launched its aggressive 29-N campaign, highlighting hardline policy proposals on young voter housing, strict anti-squatting measures, and mass citizenship reviews for foreign nationals. Abascal and right-wing allies like Argentina's Javier Milei are rallying supporters to dismantle Pedro Sánchez's coalition government.
hotspots.affect: Combative populist framing, anti-immigrant policies, and polarized cross-border ideological endorsements generate widespread emotional momentum.

hotspots.title: Hungarian Orban Ex-Minister Buried Cash Corruption Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian authorities uncovered nearly $20 million in hidden and buried cash linked to former Orbán minister Miklós Seszták, igniting a political earthquake. Opposition leader Péter Magyar has mobilized heavy rhetoric branding the ruling party a collapsing mafia, while Fidesz and KDNP leadership demand Seszták surrender his parliamentary seat.
hotspots.affect: Sensational imagery of buried Millions coupled with existential threats to Orbán's party hegemony fuel acute political outrage and moral scandal.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative für Deutschland has officially nominated 1990 World Cup champion and prominent COVID-19 policy critic Thomas Berthold as its candidate for German Federal President. The move has provoked widespread political reaction and media pushback across Germany as AfD leaders frame the nomination as a stand against the political establishment.
hotspots.affect: Culture-war symbolism and political provocation drive heavy media coverage and polarized public commentary.

hotspots.title: Brazilian Prosecutor Seeks Rejection of Bolsonaro Annulment
hotspots.blurb: Brazil's Prosecutor General (PGR) has reaffirmed its recommendation to uphold Jair Bolsonaro's 27-year prison conviction, shutting down annulment efforts. Simultaneously, internal rift inside the Liberal Party deepens as Flávio Bolsonaro maneuvers against party backing for Congressional leadership and issues dire warnings about economic doom.
hotspots.affect: Persistent legal peril for the movement's titular head combined with high-stakes factional political fights drives continuous movement grievance.
